heading: About Me
paragraphs:
Hey. I'm Jonathan Idy.
I am a software Engineer with practical expertise in Next.js, NestJS, Node and System Design. I help startups and businesses deploy web solutions that optimize throughput and automate where it makes sense. I'm business-oriented and make sure the code I deliver justifies the capital invested.
The latest project I have been working on is https://elenem.site — a SaaS tool that helps sport leagues instantly deploy a website and manage games and standings, creating great value and engagement.

Another example is https://lebourgeois.cd — an intentional travel agency platform. In the DRC region, travellers had poor access to airline schedules and pricing; we built a tool to aggregate schedules and prices, significantly improving booking conversions for the agency.
I enjoy building pragmatic systems with measurable business impact. If you'd like to talk, reach me at rajjysrachid@gmail.com.
